finding.title: Catch block swallows batch errors
finding.claim: The catch block in runAll swallows the failure: it logs the error but never rethrows, so callers continue as if the batch had succeeded.

verifier.reason: The catch block rethrows the error at src/batch.js:6, so it does not swallow the failure.

finding.title: Pagination slice returns one extra item
finding.claim: items.slice(start, start + size + 1) returns size + 1 elements because slice end is exclusive, so every page leaks one item from the next page.

verifier.reason: At src/pagination.js:3 the code returns items.slice(start, start + size + 1) with start computed at src/pagination.js:2, so the exclusive end yields size+1 items per full page, confirming the off-by-one.

finding.title: Missing await before reading rotated token
finding.claim: store.save is not awaited before store.get, so the rotated token read can return the previous token and the caller receives a stale value.

verifier.reason: At src/auth.js:2 store.save(userId, token) is called without await and src/auth.js:3 immediately returns store.get(userId), so there is no ordering guarantee that an asynchronous save completes before the read.
